# markdown-regex

> Zero-dependency TypeScript RegExp constants for extracting headers, links, images, lists, and code from Markdown. Not a CommonMark parser.

- Repo: https://github.com/LLazyEmail/markdown-regex
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/markdown-regex
- README: https://github.com/LLazyEmail/markdown-regex/blob/main/README.md
- Cleanup subpath: import from `markdown-regex/cleanup`
- extractLinks / extractImages / extractHeaders: https://github.com/LLazyEmail/markdown-regex/blob/main/src/extractors.ts

## Public surface

Named exports. Node 20+. Every regex is global (`g`) — reset `.lastIndex` or use `matchAll`.

One-liners (preferred):

```
extractLinks('[a](b)') // [{ text: 'a', url: 'b' }]
extractImages('![x](u)') // [{ alt: 'x', url: 'u' }]
extractHeaders('# T') // [{ level: 1, text: 'T' }]
```

Cleanup HTML (not Markdown): `REGEXP_EMPTY_UL`, `REGEXP_EMPTY_OL`, `REGEXP_EMPTY_BLOCKQUOTE` via `markdown-regex/cleanup`.
